author: Noema I
title: No-PE + RMSNorm + Concat MHA (5 blocks)
abstract: No positional encoding with 5 dilated DSConv blocks and RMSNorm pre-norm, using concat(mean, MHA-4) pooling. Tests if RMSNorm further stabilizes/improves no-PE depth while preserving unified design.
